question.text: Which of the following statements is not true about sucrose?

options.text: It is also named as invert sugar.

The glycosidic linkage is present Between <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></math> -glucose and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi></math> -fructose.
On hydrolysis, it produces glucose and fructose.

solution.text:
Sucrose is a disaccharide which is formed due to glycosidic linkage between C1 of α- glucose and C2 of β- fructose.

Sucrose also named as invert sugar, and it is a non-reducing sugar.
